built.note: Coexistence build ("One Index, End to End") from the AE-discovery-notes rebrief -- migrate the Barron's 400 index end-to-end onto a target Iceberg/Polaris lake while the rest of the SQL Agent/SSIS estate keeps running, one lineage graph across both. 7 assets matching the brief's own explicit enumeration (its '~8 assets' prose note doesn't match its 7-item list; built the named list, same resolution used for earlier builds' identical mismatches): legacy_estate (2 assets, the real community-registry ssis_workspace component, action: noop, demo-mode subclassed as DemoSsisWorkspaceComponent, observed via its polling sensor), lakehouse_ingestion (2 daily-partitioned assets, the real community-registry iceberg_io_manager component, demo-mode subclassed as DemoIcebergIOManagerComponent writing genuine Iceberg tables to a local zero-credential PyIceberg SQL catalog -- verified end-to-end in a scratch project before use), index_calculation/customer_egress/reporting (3 graph-first assets, Axis 2 stubbed). 3 brief-named checks (2 blocking feed-arrival, 1 warning day-over-day bounds) plus 2 bonus native SSIS freshness-lag checks, all real and green against deterministic seeded data (60-symbol synthetic universe, reproduced identically across a genuinely fresh clone). 1 freshness policy on barrons_400_constituents (4h fail/2h warn, this build's own assumption), eager automation gated on the two blocking feed checks, one 5am ET ingestion schedule (also this build's own assumption). Overrode the AE notes' own suggested live-planted-failure demo step per house rules -- flagged in README/notification, not silently dropped. defs/ is 6 YAML, 8 Python -- all 7 assets are YAML-instantiated. Three real registry gaps found and worked around (SSIS: no partitions_def, observation sensor ignoring get_asset_spec's key override, freshness check unrunnable via a job on a noop asset; Iceberg: no namespace bootstrap) -- recorded in component-feedback/2026-09-24-ssis-workspace-gaps.md and component-feedback/2026-09-24-iceberg-io-manager-namespace-bootstrap.md. Full validation gate green (dg check defs/yaml, dg list defs/components, validate_e2e.py, preflight_deploy.sh); verified zero-setup from a genuinely fresh git clone. DEPLOY BLOCKED, not a code-quality failure: dagster-cloud serverless deploy-python-executable --build-method local now refuses PEX fast-deploys for this org ('Fast deploys (PEX) are not supported on Serverless (Kubernetes) - baking your build into a Docker image instead') and falls back to a Docker build this sandbox has no daemon for (confirmed: docker CLI present, dockerd hangs with no output, no systemd) -- a platform-side change since the last successful deploy (demo-bokadirekt, 2026-09-15), not something this build caused. No partial location was left in Dagster+ (confirmed via dg api code-location list). The branch and PR are the complete deliverable; give the live demo locally via dg dev per the README's own guidance, and redeploy manually once Docker is available or the org's serverless agent reverts.

Self-serve PLG follow-up ('Ship the Second Deployment') for Noel Mattar's Dagster Starter trial -- built from a 9/9 support-call transcript, not AE discovery notes; no formal qualification process. 7 assets matching the brief's own enumerated list: raw_bookings_feed (a core-Dagster @dg.observable_source_asset, bigquery-badged, standing in for 'the model that ingests data' from Noel's own project -- registry searched for bigquery ingestion/observation components first, nothing fit 'observe an existing table for freshness' so no registry gap recorded), raw/raw_specialists (dbt's own implicit source-node asset, no dedicated Dagster asset needed), 4 real dbt Core models (2 staging + 2 marts, BokadirektDbtComponent subclassing DbtProjectComponent for the bigquery+dbt kind badge, mirroring Noel's own 'clean'/'entity' folder split), and specialist_utilization_daily (Axis-2 stubbed Python asset mirroring the Python model already in his project). 3 asset checks (2 blocking: stg_bookings completeness, fct_bookings_daily completeness gating the rollup; 1 warning: stg_specialists GDPR schema/PII shape) plus 9 dbt-native tests, all real and green against seeded deterministic data (843 bookings/40 specialists, reproduced identically across three separate runs including a genuinely fresh clone). 1 freshness policy (fct_bookings_daily), eager automation on staging+entity+rollup gated on blocking checks, one opt-in (default-off) observation sensor on raw_bookings_feed, one 07:00 Europe/Stockholm morning schedule (Stockholm is Bokadirekt's real confirmed HQ, not a guess -- the hour itself is this build's own assumption). defs/ is 2 YAML, 5 Python -- all 5 dbt-mapped assets are YAML-instantiated; the 5 .py files (observable source asset + sensor, one Axis-2 rollup, 2 template_vars modules, 3 checks) are each justified in README as having no registry-coverable integration surface. Verified zero-setup from a genuinely fresh git clone (uv sync + validate_e2e.py, identical row counts). Full validation gate green (dg check defs/yaml, dg list defs/components, validate_e2e.py, preflight); deployed and independently confirmed LOADED via dg api code-location list. The money shot (branch deployment -> second production deployment) is entirely a Dagster+ platform capability, demonstrated live in the room, never built in this repo.

Coexistence build (pattern 4) for a doc-only, no-meeting-booked brief built from an internal AE business-case document (last live demo Aug 5 2026) -- Stonebranch/Ansible stays master for infra scheduling; Dagster owns freshness/quality/cross-BU lineage across four business units (battery_materials, catalysis/AC, recycling, specialty_materials). 14 assets: battery_materials + catalysis raw layers via a real dagster-databricks DatabricksWorkspaceComponent (demo-mode subclassed as DemoDatabricksWorkspaceComponent, one instance/assets_by_job_task_key mapping covering both jobs), recycling + specialty_materials via a generic WarehouseTableAssetsComponent stub (no ingestion tool named in the brief), a Stonebranch-triggered Azure Data Factory pipeline (community registry azure_data_factory, demo-mode subclassed, reusing the same monkeypatch seam and sensor/key-override gaps first documented for demos/rvu-tempcover) observed via its own polling sensor and consumed downstream by recycling's raw asset (the one point in the graph where the legacy-scheduled and Dagster-owned sides visibly meet), 8 real dbt Core models (4 staging + 4 marts: cross-BU consolidated ledger, executive reporting extract, EU Battery Regulation carbon-footprint inputs + report), and a Power BI semantic-model refresh downstream of the executive extract. Money shot: materializing the specialty-materials raw feed cascades through 2 downstream dbt marts via eager automation (gated on the raw asset's own blocking arrival check), answering the brief's named 3-job-sequential-chain pain directly. Native dagster_databricks.DatabricksWorkspaceComponent has no job-run observation sensor at all (unlike the ADF/Power BI workspace-component convention) -- added one in the subclass, documented in component-feedback/2026-09-12-databricks-workspace-observation-sensor.md with the full registry search record (databricks_table_observation_sensor is table-freshness, not job-run history -- confirmed not a fit). 3 asset checks (2 blocking: specialty-materials arrival, battery carbon-footprint-inputs completeness; 1 warning: AC feed quality) plus 22 dbt-native tests, all real and green; 2 freshness policies (corporate rollup, AC feed); one morning schedule for the raw layer, the only fixed-time trigger in the graph. defs/ is 6 YAML, 7 Python -- all 14 assets are YAML-instantiated, zero hand-written Python asset bodies (the 7 .py files are 3 checks + 1 schedule + 3 template_vars modules, all justified in README). Full validation gate green (dg check defs/yaml, dg list defs/components, validate_e2e.py -- 14 assets, both sensors emit observation events, all 25 checks pass, real I/O confirmed in DuckDB); verified zero-setup from a genuinely fresh clone. One transient PEX-build network timeout on the first deploy attempt (files.pythonhosted.org read timeout), succeeded cleanly on retry -- not a packaging bug, consistent with demos/partners-fcu's identical experience. Deployed and independently confirmed LOADED via dg api.

Build-a-pipeline demo ('Dependencies, Not Duct Tape') for a re-engagement 'Pro vs. OSS' meeting after a stalled year-old Dagster OSS pilot -- answers the brief's three named asks (alerting, quality checks, partitioned assets) directly. 10 assets: 3 SQL-Server-badged daily-partitioned raw ingestion assets via the real registry mssql_io_manager component (subclassed as DemoMSSQLIOManagerComponent for a demo-mode DuckDB-backed I/O-boundary swap, per templates/demo_mode_pattern.py's resource-seam variant), 6 dbt assets (real dbt Core, staging+marts, badged dbt+snowflake via a DbtProjectComponent subclass overriding get_asset_spec -- Snowflake per the AE's 'likely adding' framing, flagged as an assumption), 1 plain reporting asset with no kind badge (no BI tool named anywhere in the brief). Two blocking completeness checks (raw_member_transactions, raw_loan_originations) plus 13 dbt-native tests plus one warning reconciliation check, all real and green; one freshness policy on fct_daily_member_activity; eager automation on the dbt layer gated on the two blocking checks for their direct dependents; one 06:00 America/New_York morning schedule (assumed timezone/hour, not stated in the brief). WarehouseTableAssetsComponent (same accepted pattern as demos/noleggiare) supplies the small deterministic stub bodies the raw layer writes through the real IO manager -- Axis 1 requires genuine I/O for the blocking checks and dbt sources to have something real to query, even though Axis 2 fidelity is graph-first per the brief. No custom component was needed (mssql_io_manager covered the only external system in scope), so no component-feedback/ entry. Full validation gate green (dg check defs/yaml, dg list defs/components, validate_e2e.py across partitioned/unpartitioned chains, 19 checks all evaluated and passing); verified zero-setup from a genuine fresh git clone; deployed and independently confirmed LOADED via dg api. One transient PEX-build network timeout on the first deploy attempt (files.pythonhosted.org read timeout), succeeded cleanly on retry -- not a packaging bug.

Project directory renamed from the initial demos/eon_sverige (matching the Python package name) to demos/eon-sverige mid-build to match the ledger/brief slug convention scripts/reset_demo.sh, pull_demo.sh, and request.sh all assume. Full validation gate green (dg check defs/yaml, dg list defs/components, validate_e2e.py across multi-partitioned/daily-partitioned/unpartitioned chains); verified zero-setup from a fresh clone; deployed and independently confirmed LOADED via dg api.

REBUILD (corrects PR #16, reverted -- requests/done/noleggiare-2026-09-03.md): the prior build routed every Postgres/Snowflake-badged asset through a home-made GraphFirstAssetsComponent with zero real I/O, the exact anti-pattern CLAUDE.md bans by name, despite the brief naming dagster-postgres and dagster-snowflake explicitly. This build fixes it: dagster-component search 'postgres'/'snowflake' --json found real registry IO manager components (postgres_io_manager wrapping SQLAlchemy+psycopg2, snowflake_io_manager wrapping dagster-snowflake-pandas's SnowflakePandasIOManager), installed via dagster-component add, subclassed once each (DemoPostgresIOManagerComponent, DemoSnowflakeIOManagerComponent) to swap the IO manager resource for dagster-duckdb-pandas's DuckDBPandasIOManager only when demo_mode=true (default false path calls the exact unmodified registry component). WarehouseTableAssetsComponent (replacing the banned GraphFirstAssetsComponent) now writes real deterministic stub rows through io_manager_key so genuine I/O lands in two separate DuckDB files -- validate_e2e.py asserts real tables/rows exist post-materialize, not just that materialize succeeded (11 tables/110 rows postgres-badged, 1 table/20 rows snowflake-badged). Same 14-asset graph, 3 checks, 1 freshness policy, eager automation, one schedule as the prior build; qlik_cloud_export (rung-4 custom, no registry component for Qlik Cloud) and fleet_residual_value_forecast (Axis-2 plain asset, no I/O) unchanged. Deviates from the brief's literal 'bodies are pass' Fidelity wording per CLAUDE.md's explicit precedence (Axis 1 overrides brief fidelity) -- noted in README/PR. Full validation gate green; verified zero-setup from a fresh clone; deployed and independently confirmed LOADED via dg api.

REBUILD (honors requests/done/rvu-tempcover-2026-09-03-r2.md, a second correction after PR #18): Fivetran and Power BI already used real components, but Azure Data Factory -- the incumbent the whole demo thesis argues against ('ADF can tell you a job ran; this shows whether the data was right') -- was still prose only, with no asset in the graph. This build adds it: DemoAzureDataFactoryComponent, a demo-mode subclass of the registry's azure_data_factory component (dagster_community_components.AzureDataFactoryComponent), materializing and observed via a polling sensor (defaults true on this component, unlike Fivetran/PowerBI), in a new legacy_orchestration group shown side by side with (not chained into) the new pipeline. This departs from the brief's own 'no legacy orchestrator to observe' framing per CLAUDE.md's explicit precedence (requests/ overrides the brief) -- noted in README's 'Correction this build makes' section. Surfaced two real registry gaps, both in component-feedback/2026-09-03-azure-data-factory-demo-mode-seam.md: no overridable execution method (worked around via a process-lifetime monkeypatch of the module's network-boundary free function, since the trigger-and-poll logic is inlined with no seam) and the observation sensor ignoring assets_by_pipeline_name's key override (confirmed empirically by evaluating the sensor directly; worked around by not overriding the key, locked in with a new validate_e2e.py assertion that sensor and asset agree on identity). Fivetran, dbt, Power BI, and Braze unchanged from PR #18 -- same components, same graph, same checks; this is additive, not a re-derivation (most reused files are byte-identical per git diff). 13 assets total (was 12). Full validation gate green (dg check defs/yaml, dg list defs, dg list components, validate_e2e.py, preflight); verified zero-setup from a fresh copy; deployed and independently confirmed LOADED via dg api.
